title: Maintenance Assistant
description:
Community Care Center, a 161- bed behavioral facility located in the heart of Duarte, Ca.

Urgently hiring for a Full time Maintenance Assistant

POSITION SUMMARY

The purpose of your job position is to assist the Maintenance Manager with the day-to-day activities (installing, repairing and upkeep) of the facility in accordance with current applicable federal, state, and local standards and regulations that govern the facility and to ensure the safety of all residents and personnel as directed by your supervisor and/or the Administrator.

The Maintenance Assistant will treat each resident with kindness, dignity and respect. They will work cooperatively with all departments and multidisciplinary teams. They will be committed to always doing the right thing.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reminding staff to follow all safety regulations, facility policies and hand-washing procedures

  • Performing regular inspections of resident rooms for order safety and proper performance of equipment

  • Providing or scheduling facility repairs as needed

  • Using protective safety equipment as required

  • Monitoring electrical and hydraulic systems routinely to ensure functionality

  • Coordinating routine terminal isolation procedures with nursing and housekeeping

  • Confirming that containers of hazardous chemicals in the department are properly labeled and stored

  • Assisting in maintaining material data safety sheets (MSDS)

  • Ensuring that assigned personnel wear and use protective safety equipment as required

  • Ensuring that fire protection and prevention programs are maintained by all personnel

  • Maintaining the facilities interior and exterior area neat

  • Keeping the storage area neat and safe

  • Ensuring all equipment is cleaned and properly stored at the end of each shift

  • Maintaining maintenance logs weekly, monthly and quarterly as required

  • Working within parameters of operational budget

  • Attending annual in-service meetings

  • Follow safety regulations and precautions at all times

  • Reporting any occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, or other hazardous materials to a supervisor immediately

Every effort has been made to identify the essential functions of this position. However, it in no way states or implies these are the only duties you will be required to perform as directed by management. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or is an essential function of the position.

REQUIREMENTS

Education / Licensure

  • High school diploma or GED preferred

  • Trade school or college courses in HVAC, electrical, and plumbing, etc. a plus

Qualifications / Experience

  • Must have minimum of 1 year experience working in skilled nursing or hospital setting

  • Must have knowledge of carpentry, electrical, HVAC, and plumbing

  • Must be able to safely troubleshoot and repair equipment

  • Must be able to read, write, and speak the English language

  • Must be able to follow detailed directions

Working Conditions

  • May encounter frequent interruptions and need to reschedule maintenance activities

  • May be requested to work beyond scheduled working hours at times such as weekends and holidays

  • Is subject to call-back during emergency conditions (e.g., severe weather, evacuation, post-disaster, etc.)

  • May be necessary to assist in the evacuation of residents during emergency situations

  • May be exposed to infectious waste, diseases, conditions, etc., including TB and the AIDS and Hepatitis B viruses

  • May be required to work in cramped spaces and in adverse weather conditions

  • May be subjected to odors, dust, disinfectants, tobacco smoking or air contaminants

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to move intermittently throughout the day in all different areas of the facility

  • Must be able to stand, bend and reach throughout the day

  • Repetitive hand motion

  • Must be able to push, pull, move and or lift up to 50 lbs. on occasion to a minimum height of 5 feet and be able to push, pull, move, and/or carry such weight a minimum distance of 15 feet

  • Ability to read fine print on equipment or operational pamphlets

title: Inventory and Finance Assistant
description:
Inventory and Finance Assistant

Bill Jacobs BMW | Naperville, IL


About the Opportunity

Bill Jacobs BMW is seeking a highly organized, detail-driven, and proactive Inventory and Finance Assistant to support our Sales, Finance & Insurance, and vehicle inventory operations.

This is a hands-on dealership operations role responsible for helping ensure vehicle inventory is accurately received and accounted for, deals and manufacturer reporting are processed correctly, CPO and dealer trade processes are completed timely, and Sales and F&I operations run efficiently.

The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, catches details others may miss, and thrives in a fast-paced dealership environment. This person will work closely with Sales, F&I, Accounting, Service, Inventory, and dealership leadership to keep vehicles, paperwork, reporting, and operational processes moving.


About Bill Jacobs Motorsport

Bill Jacobs Motorsport is a premier Chicagoland automotive dealer group representing BMW, MINI, Volkswagen, Land Rover, and Jaguar. We are committed to delivering an exceptional experience for our guests while creating a professional, collaborative environment where employees can build meaningful careers.


What You'll Do

Sales & F&I Operations

  • Serve as a key quality-control point for vehicle transactions by reviewing deal paperwork, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring completed deals move efficiently to Accounting.
  • Manage Retail Delivery Reporting (RDR) and ensure manufacturer submissions are timely and accurate.
  • Track and reconcile manufacturer incentives, rebates, bonuses, and other sales programs.
  • Maintain accurate Sales and F&I reports and provide leadership with timely updates and information.
  • Assist with the processing and administration of F&I products, contracts, cancellations, and related documentation.
  • Serve as a professional point of contact for guests regarding F&I products, documentation, and post-sale follow-up.
  • Conduct Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) follow-up calls to ensure guests are satisfied with their purchase and address questions or concerns.
  • Provide administrative and operational support to the General Sales Manager and Sales & F&I leadership.
  • Assist with deal tracking, reporting, documentation, and other operational responsibilities as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, prevent errors, and keep deals moving efficiently.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive customer, financial, and dealership information.

New & Used Vehicle Inventory

  • Physically accept and stock-in all new and used vehicle inventory, ensuring vehicles are accurately received and entered into the dealership's systems.
  • Inspect incoming new vehicles and ensure any damage is documented on the Bill of Lading and reported to the manufacturer with photographic evidence within 24 hours.
  • Create stock numbers, verify vehicle information in CDK, assign costs, and print vehicle and key tags.
  • Check keys into Key Track for all new and used vehicles.
  • Enroll applicable like-make vehicles into POIS as either Used or Certified Pre-Owned (CPO).
  • Ensure Carfax reports and required CPO documentation are completed and provided to the appropriate internal advisor.
  • Write up vehicles and document important vehicle information on the outside of the deal jacket, including number of keys, interior and exterior colors, manuals, and other pertinent details.
  • File deal jackets in the appropriate filing system and maintain organized inventory documentation.

Dealer Trades

  • Review dealer trade requests with the New Vehicle Sales Manager.
  • Coordinate and complete dealer trades with other dealerships.
  • Prepare required paperwork for billing.
  • Stock-in incoming vehicles when applicable.
  • Collect Certificates of Origin and ensure all required documentation is complete.
  • Coordinate delivery of paperwork and applicable checks to the other dealer.

Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) Process

  • Coordinate and maintain CPO deal bag and documentation requirements.
  • Print Carfax reports and perform and print the initial key read.
  • Print the initial DCS service history.
  • Enter eligible vehicles into POIS as CPO.
  • Reprint the service DCS showing CPO enrollment.
  • Document the applicable CPO fee on the CPO checklist.
  • Ensure all required CPO documentation is completed and delivered to the appropriate internal advisor.

Inventory Audits & Controls

  • Conduct weekly inventory audits by comparing the physical inventory to inventory posted in CDK and BMW/MINI RDR reports.
  • Identify and investigate inventory discrepancies.
  • Immediately notify management of discrepancies involving vehicle location, status, stock numbers, or system records.
  • Maintain accurate records to support inventory control, reporting, and accounting processes.

Service Loaner Facilitation

  • RDR applicable vehicles into the Service Loaner fleet.
  • Send appropriate notifications to all necessary dealership personnel.
  • Change vehicle status in CDK to the appropriate “G” status.
  • Track service loaner vehicles and ensure records remain accurate.
  • Stock-in former loaner vehicles once they have been removed from loaner service and are either miled-out or sold.

Month-End & Clerical Operations

  • Reconcile and post AVP and BBP funds.
  • Process product and warranty cancellations across applicable stores.
  • Remit product and warranty funds for applicable stores, including Continental and Protective products.
  • Assist with month-end reporting, reconciliation, documentation, and other dealership accounting support as needed.
  • Maintain organized records and documentation to support accurate month-end close processes.

Sales Department Supplies & Support

  • Monitor sales department supply needs.
  • Order clerical and vehicle marketing supplies for the Sales departments.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory of frequently used supplies.
  • Provide general administrative and operational support to Sales leadership as needed.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Sales, F&I, Accounting, Service, Inventory, and dealership leadership to support a seamless operation.
  • Communicate issues promptly and help identify solutions before they impact the customer or dealership.
  • Maintain professional working relationships with dealership employees, vendors, manufacturers, and other business partners.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by dealership leadership.

Why Join Bill Jacobs BMW?

This is more than an administrative position. The Sales & F&I Operations Assistant will have visibility across Sales, F&I, Accounting, Inventory, and Service operations and will play an important role in ensuring the dealership's vehicles, transactions, reporting, and documentation are accurate and completed efficiently.

For the right candidate, this position provides an opportunity to develop broad dealership expertise across Sales, F&I, Accounting, Inventory, CPO, manufacturer programs, and dealership operations while working alongside experienced dealership leadership.

If you are organized, accountable, detail-driven, and someone who takes pride in getting things right, we want to hear from you.

Apply today and grow your career with Bill Jacobs BMW.

Caregiver Responsibilities:

As a caregiver with Right at Home, you will assist clients with daily activities such as mobility, housekeeping, meal preparation, personal hygiene, medication reminders, and more. Your role may also include providing companionship and support during appointments and errands.

Caregiver Qualifications:

  • High school graduate or G.E.D. certificate preferred.

  • Proficient in English (reading, writing, speaking).

  • Reliable Transportation.

  • Pass a background check.

  • CNA, Home Health Aide, or Personal Care Aide certification is preferred but not required.
